name: yf_forex_history
description:
Daily exchange-rate history for one currency pair from Yahoo Finance.
Returns: {pair, period, data_points (all days in the period), truncated, rates: the most recent limit days, oldest first, each {Date, Open, High, Low, Close, Volume, Dividends, Stock Splits}}.
Inputs (* required): pair (EURUSD, EUR/USD or EURUSD=X; "=X" is appended when missing; default EURUSD=X); period (1mo, 3mo, 6mo, 1y, ...; default 3mo); limit (days, 1-1000; default 100).
Other sources: openbb_forex_historical (date range), av_forex_daily; current rate: av_forex_rate.
Example: {"pair": "USDINR", "period": "1y", "limit": 30}

pair.description: Currency pair, e.g. EURUSD or EURUSD=X (=X is appended if missing)
